description: Grafana-style operations dashboard showing inference gateway latency spike. P99 latency increases from 200ms to 4,500ms over 15 minutes. Error rate panel shows correlated increase from 0.1% to 3.2%. Service status panel shows 2 of 5 inference pods unhealthy.
visual_elements: p99 latency time-series chart (blue line, spike at 14:23 UTC)
service status panel (2 unhealthy pods highlighted red)
demo_context: This screenshot represents what an on-call engineer would see during an inference gateway degradation event caused by Gaudi memory pressure.
